title.narrative: Improved labour migration governance frameworks in line with ILS through regional collaboration

description.narrative: Jordan hosts a significant migrant workforce employed across key sectors, many of whom face barriers to effective representation in trade unions and participation in social dialogue. This programme supports efforts to strengthen the capacity of workers’ organizations to organize, include, and represent migrant workers, including in sectors such as domestic work and the care economy where women are highly represented. During the biennium, it will contribute to improved outreach, expanded membership, and more inclusive representation structures, as well as enhanced engagement of migrant workers in collective processes. By addressing challenges related to informality, recruitment practices, and working conditions, the programme contributes to strengthening labour standards and promoting decent work for all. The programme will primarily benefit migrant workers and workers’ organizations and will be implemented in collaboration with national and international stakeholders to support inclusive labour market governance.
